# AppleSkinPumpkin

<!-- docs:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by pumpkin-plugins-docs. Edit src/info.ts, then run `pnpm readme`. -->

The plugin syncs saturation and exhaustion so AppleSkin can show accurate food stats.
<!-- docs:end summary -->

## Installation

<!-- docs:begin installation -->
<!-- Generated by pumpkin-plugins-docs. Edit src/info.ts, then run `pnpm readme`. -->

Download `apple-skin-pumpkin.wasm` from the plugin's GitHub release, put it in your server's `plugins/` folder, and restart Pumpkin. On the first load, a full restart lets Pumpkin ask for the plugin's permissions; hot reload cannot prompt for them.
<!-- docs:end installation -->

## How it works

Vanilla tells a client about saturation only when it reaches zero, and never sends exhaustion at
all, which leaves the food tooltips AppleSkin draws behind by a tick. So the plugin reads every
online player once per tick and sends the two values, plus whether the world heals players by food.
It reads that game rule once per world rather than once per player, and sends only what moved since
the last packet, so it sends nothing for a still player.

AppleSkin is a Java Edition mod, so Bedrock players are skipped.

## Seeing what it does

Set `logging.level` to `debug` in your Pumpkin config. Every packet the plugin sends is then logged
with the player and the value, along with players joining, leaving and being skipped. After one line
for the first tick, ticks where nothing changed are silent, which is the point of only sending on a
change.

## Permissions

<!-- docs:begin permissions -->
<!-- Generated by pumpkin-plugins-docs. Edit src/info.ts, then run `pnpm readme`. -->

Pumpkin asks you to approve these on the server console when it loads the plugin. It skips the question when the `[plugins]` table in `pumpkin.toml` lists all of them in `allowed_permissions` or sets `ask_permission_confirmation = false`. Pumpkin remembers your answer and asks again after the plugin file or this list changes.

| Permission | Why |
| --- | --- |
| `http.outbound` | Check Pumpkin Market for plugin updates. |
<!-- docs:end permissions -->
